title: spec/02a:263 Off-by-one: >3 missed beacons vs BEACON_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES=3
description: Section 2a.6.2 state transition table says SYNCED->DESYNCED on '>3 missed beacons' (meaning 4 or more). Section 2a.6.3 defines BEACON_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES=3 with description 'Consecutive missed beacons before DESYNCED' (implying transition at 3). Implementations following the table would transition at 4 missed beacons; implementations following the parameter would transition at 3. Causes interop failure in mixed deployments. Fix: Either change table to '>=3' or change BEACON_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES to 4.
